item.title: Disney Plus is also becoming TikTok
item.description: Netflix isn't the only SVOD service taking cues from the world of free social video hubs. Disney revealed the new feed during a showcase at CES in Las Vegas. item.title: Precisify deploys $26 million investment to buy into the booming creator marketplace
item.description: Precise TV has rebranded to become Precisify. The London-based ad tech provider, which delivers intelligence and other insights to partners through its proprietary audience panels, is positioning its rebrand as a means of "re-introducing ourselves," as Co-Founder and Co-CEO Christian Dankl put it in a statement. The new Precisify, Dankl said, is "the only digital engine that makes $1 million work like $1.6 million with zero tolerance for brand risk." Visit Tubefilter for more great stories.

item.title: With 420,000 daily Twitch viewers, is Hytale the successor to Minecraft and Roblox?
item.description: Hytale just enjoyed one of the strongest opening days in Twitch history. That total was easily big enough to make Hytale the most-watched game on Twitch. item.title: What’s next for 2026? TikTok says “curiosity detours” will captivate us.
item.description: TikTok's close connection to the youth zeitgeist is an essential part of its pitch to potential brand partners.
